contract.task_clause:
The purpose of establishing quality control policies and procedures for deciding whether to accept or continue a client relationship is to
Option A: Provide reasonable assurance that personnel are adequately trained to fulfill their responsibilities.
Option B: Minimize the likelihood of associating with clients whose management lacks integrity.
Option C: Document the matters that are required to be communicated to the audit committee.
Option D: Enhance the auditor's understanding of the client's business and its industry.
